description: The presentation of a TmOnboardingChecklist: a plain list, one card surface (the setup guide) or a tile grid (the tips panel).

members.name: List
members.description: A plain vertical list without card chrome — the default, suitable for a sidebar or a page section that already provides its own surface.

members.name: Card
members.description: One card surface: the title header, the progress block and the list inside a bordered, rounded panel. The setup-guide presentation.

members.name: Grid
members.description: A responsive tile grid — each step becomes a tile in an auto-fitting column track. The tips-panel presentation; prefer it for short titles, because a tile has much less room for a description than a list row.
